text_en: Get back! Don't come any closer! I know what you're trying to do!
We heroes always arrive at the last second, have no fear!
Wait! You weren't going to intervene... were you?
You heard Liandris. These beings are not part of this, nor were they brought by us. We cannot ignore them any longer.
It hasn't touched him, but he's suffered a fall. Take him to the city quickly, he will recover.
But of course...
Erm... Are you alright?
Is it something I said?
Sangrigor! What's happening?!
WHAT'S HAPP...
Sangrigor!
AAAH!
Wait!
(Sangrigor... Hmm, I don't see that parasite anywhere either. I must tell Liandris)
Wow, I don't normally have that effect on people...
What exactly just happened? Because, if you know, I'd quite like to be made aware.
Oh! I nearly forgot! I need to take him to the city. That old owl will know what to do.
Aw, I'm missing out on all the fun. Captain's duties, I guess. I'll leave you to carry on. Be good.
Giddy up!
